errors: A mutation check (killpg swapped for a parent-only kill) hung instead of failing and left an orphaned sh loop; stopped the task and killed it by pid.

doc_friction.issue: Running `measure` without --no-fetch deepens the shallow clone, and afterwards every history-wide git log in the session runs ~5x slower (route 1.7 s -> 8.5 s, prompts suite 14 s -> 37 s). Perf baselines taken before and after a measure call are not comparable.

The 'where to look' items 1-4 all came up empty or owner-gated (perf backlog, priv-* pool consumers, small front doors, bet suites 2-13 s). The cost was in an agent-path CLI (`measure`, 136 s) that no list names; 'time the CLIs a review run calls' is worth adding.

notes: Metric: wall time of `python3 prompts/promptctl.py measure --no-fetch`, on the same clone and commit after the default deepen, one job at a time. Before 136.0 s (cProfile: 959 git subprocesses, 130 s in poll); after 13.1/13.8/13.6 s (6 git subprocesses); output cmp-identical (396,010 bytes). The prompts unittest suite on the same clone went from 36.9/36.6 s to 29.9/29.3 s. Per-path equivalence: 1822 paths, 0 differences vs `git log -1 -- path` after adding --diff-merges=c --no-renames to the batch log (the old index differed on 4). No post: a tooling perf change for agents, not a reader-facing finding; deviation noted. Validate ok; 159 prompts tests OK.

human_equivalent.basis: profile, three rounds of git-semantics fixes verified per path, write-up

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
server-tool fees (web search is billed per search, not per token); the count is recorded, not priced
